tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the WebGL canvas. Dark = Ink (live). Light = warm paper.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, header when solid, menus, toasts. Dark = Ink 2.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second level: inputs, skeletons, code blocks, hover fill of ghost controls. Dark = Ink 3.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on bg, surface-1, surface-2 (dark 14.9:1 min, light 14.3:1 min). Dark = Paper.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, lead paragraphs, card descriptions, on bg and both surfaces (7.0:1 min both themes). Dark = Paper dim.

tokens.name: text-mute
tokens.usage: Meta labels, captions, timestamps, mono eyebrows, on bg and both surfaces (dark 5.0:1 on surface-2, light 5.2:1). Dark = Paper mute.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section rules, card borders, table rows. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries that must meet 3:1: input borders, ghost button outline, toggle track, checkbox (3.1:1 min on surface-2).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime. FILLS only in light mode: solid buttons, the logo dot on dark, curtain wipe, highlights, active pill. In dark it may also be text (15.3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Lime as TEXT or a thin mark: links, active nav underline, eyebrow numbers, icons on bg and both surfaces (light 5.1:1 min). Use this, never accent, for text on light.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or secondary fill (15.3:1 on lime).

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Soft lime background: selected tag, toast success wash, highlight behind accent-text (light 5.8:1 for accent-text on it).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Mint. Fill only in light mode: particle secondary tint, success dot, chart second series. accent-ink on it is 11.7:1.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Mint as text or icon on bg and surfaces (light 5.5:1 min).

tokens.name: hue-1
tokens.usage: Tangerine. Project tint, tag text, chart series 1, particle tint. AA as text on bg, both surfaces and hue-1-wash in both themes (light 4.6:1 min, dark 7.2:1 min).

tokens.name: hue-1-wash
tokens.usage: Tangerine wash: tag fill, project card hover glow, aurora blob, case study hero ground. Text on it is hue-1 or text.

tokens.name: hue-2
tokens.usage: Mustard. Project tint, tag text, chart series 2, particle tint. AA as text on bg, both surfaces and hue-2-wash in both themes (light 4.6:1 min, dark 7.2:1 min).

tokens.name: hue-2-wash
tokens.usage: Mustard wash: tag fill, project card hover glow, aurora blob, case study hero ground. Text on it is hue-2 or text.

tokens.name: hue-3
tokens.usage: Sky. Project tint, tag text, chart series 3, particle tint. AA as text on bg, both surfaces and hue-3-wash in both themes (light 4.6:1 min, dark 7.2:1 min).

tokens.name: hue-3-wash
tokens.usage: Sky wash: tag fill, project card hover glow, aurora blob, case study hero ground. Text on it is hue-3 or text.

tokens.name: hue-4
tokens.usage: Violet. Project tint, tag text, chart series 4, particle tint. AA as text on bg, both surfaces and hue-4-wash in both themes (light 4.6:1 min, dark 7.2:1 min).

tokens.name: hue-4-wash
tokens.usage: Violet wash: tag fill, project card hover glow, aurora blob, case study hero ground. Text on it is hue-4 or text.

tokens.name: hue-5
tokens.usage: Teal. Project tint, tag text, chart series 5, particle tint. AA as text on bg, both surfaces and hue-5-wash in both themes (light 4.6:1 min, dark 7.2:1 min).

tokens.name: hue-5-wash
tokens.usage: Teal wash: tag fill, project card hover glow, aurora blob, case study hero ground. Text on it is hue-5 or text.

tokens.name: hue-6
tokens.usage: Rose. Project tint, tag text, chart series 6, particle tint. AA as text on bg, both surfaces and hue-6-wash in both themes (light 4.6:1 min, dark 7.2:1 min).

tokens.name: hue-6-wash
tokens.usage: Rose wash: tag fill, project card hover glow, aurora blob, case study hero ground. Text on it is hue-6 or text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive states, always with the alert icon and a written message (light 5.1:1 on surface-2). Red at hue 4 degrees, kept 20 degrees clear of hue-1 tangerine and hue-6 rose so an error never reads as a project tint.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Background behind an inline error message.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every focusable element (light 5.1:1, dark 13.2:1 on any surface).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Header and mobile-menu backdrop under a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and the open mobile menu.

tokens.name: particle-base
tokens.usage: 3D points far from the camera and at rest; mixes toward the page palette near the camera.

tokens.name: particle-tint
tokens.usage: 3D points near the camera and the pinned About explode; replaced per case study by its project hue.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero name only. One per page. Fluid 56px at 360 to 168px at 1440: font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 1.167rem + 10.37vw, 10.5rem);

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Case study hero titles, 404 numeral, footer contact line. Fluid 44px at 360 to 112px at 1440: font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 1.333rem + 6.296vw, 7rem);

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section headlines under a section header. Fluid 36px at 360 to 72px at 1440: font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.5rem + 3.333vw, 4.5rem);

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Article h2, card titles in the bento at large size. Fluid 28px at 360 to 44px at 1440: font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 1.417rem + 1.481vw, 2.75rem);

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Article h3, project card titles, timeline roles. Fluid 21px at 360 to 28px at 1440: font-size: clamp(1.312rem, 1.167rem + 0.6481vw, 1.75rem);

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat tiles and metric blocks; set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for count-ups. Fluid 48px at 360 to 96px at 1440: font-size: clamp(3rem, 2rem + 4.444vw, 6rem);

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Agent systems, fast storefronts and automation for teams who ship.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs under a headline, max 40ch. Fluid 18px at 360 to 24px at 1440: font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.5556vw, 1.5rem);

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I build retrieval pipelines, multi-agent orchestration and the websites around them.
styles.usage: Default copy, article paragraphs, max 68ch. Fluid 16px at 360 to 18px at 1440: font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.9583rem + 0.1852vw, 1.125rem);

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis, button labels at size M/L. Fluid 16px at 360 to 18px at 1440: font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.9583rem + 0.1852vw, 1.125rem);

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Toronto, Canada. Available for projects from January.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, captions, form help text. Fluid 14px at 360 to 15px at 1440: font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 0.8542rem + 0.09259vw, 0.9375rem);

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, inputs. Fluid 14px at 360 to 15px at 1440: font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 0.8542rem + 0.09259vw, 0.9375rem);

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, facts bar labels, cursor bubble. Always uppercase (text-transform). Fluid 11px at 360 to 12px at 1440: font-size: clamp(0.6875rem, 0.6667rem + 0.09259vw, 0.75rem);

styles.name: meta-l
styles.usage: Section index numbers and the marquee. Fluid 12px at 360 to 14px at 1440: font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 0.7083rem + 0.1852vw, 0.875rem);

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks; not uppercase. Fluid 14px at 360 to 15px at 1440: font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 0.8542rem + 0.09259vw, 0.9375rem);

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills and meta rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: tag rows, icon buttons, stacked meta.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap inside components; card inner padding at 360.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter at 768 to 1280.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding at 1440, gutter at 1440, space under h1.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content at 360.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between section header and content at 1440; header height inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin at 1280; between bento rows.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page side margin at 1440.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding at 360 (section-y min).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding at 768 to 1280.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding at 1440.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding, footer top padding at 1440.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Grid gutter. 16px at 360, 24px at 768 and 1280, 32px at 1440 (see Grid).

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Page margin. 20px at 360, 40px at 768, 64px at 1280, 80px at 1440.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height (64px under 768).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Code blocks, kbd, small swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, toasts, skeleton blocks, icon button (square variant).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, the theme toggle track inner, stat tiles at 360.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: project bento, case study, stat tile, metric block. The house radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Case study hero media and full-bleed images.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, pills, the theme toggle, the cursor label bubble.

shadow.note: Light mode only. Dark mode separates surfaces with line, never a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and the solid header in light mode.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Card hover, menus, toasts in light mode.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Mobile menu panel, modal, magnetic button at peak in light mode.

duration.note: Motion durations. Under prefers-reduced-motion every one becomes 0ms except fades, which become 120ms.

tokens.name: dur-micro
tokens.usage: Hover colour, underline draw, icon swap, toggle thumb (150 to 250ms band).

tokens.name: dur-ui
tokens.usage: Header show/hide, menu open, toast in, card lift (400 to 600ms band).

tokens.name: dur-section
tokens.usage: Line reveals, section enters, count-ups (900 to 1200ms band).

tokens.name: dur-curtain
tokens.usage: Page transition curtain: 450ms cover + 450ms reveal.

tokens.name: dur-morph
tokens.usage: Particle field shape morph between scenes.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Between lines in a reveal, links in the mobile menu, cards in a row. Cap the total at 480ms.

easing.note: cubic-bezier values; GSAP equivalents in the Motion section.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering: reveals, cards, toasts (expo out).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Curtain wipe, header slide, shape morph (quart in-out).

tokens.name: ease-ui
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback, toggles, underline draw.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only: toast out, menu close, elements leaving.

tokens.name: z-canvas
tokens.usage: The persistent WebGL canvas and the CSS fallback poster.

tokens.name: z-grain
tokens.usage: Film grain overlay (pointer-events none).

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Header.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Mobile menu and scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-cursor
tokens.usage: Custom cursor dot and label bubble.

tokens.name: z-curtain
tokens.usage: Page transition curtain.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Film grain overlay, both themes (light uses multiply blend).

tokens.name: canvas-quiet
tokens.usage: 3D canvas opacity behind body text and on legal pages.
